assertions.source: Exotic-basis PSLQ at 120 dps: 12 of 13 elements submitted, 1 skipped as ~0, 0 errored

description: Open-work follow-up to PR #1645: PSLQ search for the 54 ppb m_p sub-residual after (α_em/π)/6 correction, over the EXOTIC basis deferred by PR #1629 Task 2 (Bloch-Wigner D(z), Mahler measures of golden/Bring-quintic/Cassini polynomials, hyperbolic volumes, elliptic K). 120 dps, maxcoeff 10⁶, tol 10⁻²².

data.verdict: DEEPER NULL — even the exotic basis (Bloch-Wigner D(z), Mahler measures of golden/quintic/Cassini polynomials, hyperbolic volumes, elliptic integrals) does NOT identify the 54 ppb sub-residual at 120 dps tol 10⁻²². Strongly suggests the residual is at the **CODATA precision floor** for the input anchors (α_em precision 10⁻¹⁰; m_p 10⁻¹⁰; m_μ 10⁻¹⁰; m_e 10⁻¹⁰). A 54 ppb residual on a kg-scale identity is consistent with ~10⁻¹⁰ × propagation factor. Further structural derivation would need improved CODATA inputs.
